output.reason: The rendered diffs show only that the storage flag moved from v2beta1 to v2 between 1.12.6 and 1.13.0 [ev-0ab8730da6d7] [ev-5714a6388637]. Nothing shown says that anything fails, is rejected or stops working in this release. The change text says only that existing objects stay stored as v2beta1 until rewritten. The migration is needed only before some later release removes v2beta1, and no evidence shows that removal is scheduled. So migration-required claims mandatory work the evidence does not support: this is a behavior-change (review) with migration as advice, not a required step in this release.

correction.statement: From 1.12.6 to 1.13.0 the storage version of cleanuppolicies.kyverno.io changes from v2beta1 to v2. Existing CleanupPolicy objects keep working and stay stored as v2beta1 until rewritten. A storage version migration is advisable before any later release removes v2beta1.

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, new or rewritten CleanupPolicy objects are stored as v2, while existing ones stay stored as v2beta1 until rewritten. The evidence shows nothing that fails or is rejected in this release.
consequence.remediation: Optionally re-write all CleanupPolicy objects and remove v2beta1 from the CRD's status.storedVersions before any later release removes v2beta1.
